reason: Yinghua Academy (Minneapolis, K-8 Mandarin-immersion public charter, 872 students) is the right vertical and size for Kenneth's niche, but no live posting confesses the pain he fixes: the only matched job is 'Student Development and Family Liaison (Dean of Students)', a pure behavior-management/family-engagement role, and every other open role in its live feed is instructional or marketing (Licensed Reading Interventionist, PE Teacher, Extended Learning Program Lead, Marketing & Communication Coordinator, MS Social Studies Teacher, ELL Teacher) -- a generic 'a school is hiring staff' match with zero technology-governance signal. The situation is also contradicted: the school has had an in-house IT Manager (Chemin Chu, Technology Coordinator 2009-2013, IT Manager 2013-present) who owns 'IT devices, software, staff training, and student database', so it is not a school with outsourced IT and no technology leadership. No quotable line => drop.

notes.one_liner: The first public charter Chinese-immersion school in the U.S. -- a full Mandarin-immersion K-8 in Minneapolis, founded 2006.
notes.why_it_looked_promising: Charter school in the 800-2,000 student band, elected 13-member board with a Governance committee, board-approved policies -- matches Kenneth's firmographics exactly. Dropped on situation and evidence, not on vertical.
notes.revisit_if: A live posting appears for a technology/IT leadership, data-privacy, or student-information-systems role, or the IT Manager departs, or the board publishes a technology/cybersecurity plan gap.
